resources.string: Kill to shorten your cooldown and become War.
Kill players to reduce your cooldown. Collect enough kills to become <color=#5E3929>War</color>.

The Berserker is a Neutral Apocalypse role. Each kill lowers your kill cooldown, helping you snowball into War. Once transformed, you lose cooldown reduction and become an invincible horseman who can chain kills during a short spree window. If Apocalypse Wins Together is enabled, Apocalypse roles are treated as allies.
War has consumed the battlefield.\%nl\%\%color=#5E3929FF\%War\%/color\%, Horseman of the Apocalypse, has emerged!
Chain kills during your short spree window. War is invincible and can only die by exile.

The <color=#5E3929>War</color> is the transformed Berserker and a Horseman of the Apocalypse. War is immune to attacks and hostile abilities, kills without losing momentum during a short spree window, and can only be killed by being voted out.
